dialogue_texts: Mayohiga... a place of lost things and hidden paths.
It feels unusually stagnant today, as if the air itself is refusing to flow.
Well now, if it isn't the Empress herself. To what do we owe the honor of a royal visit to our humble village?
I am tracing a certain "glohm" substance that threatens the balance of the kingdoms, including my own.
It is a dull matter, but one that requires my personal attention.
"Glohm," you say? If that filth tries to settle here, I'll purify every last drop of it.
A shrine maiden's duty is to keep her home clean, after all.
A kitsune acting as a shrine maiden... How quaint.
I wonder if your "purification" can handle the standards of the Eternal Night.
You look a bit tense from all that royal posturing, my Majesty.
Actually, no. I will have you do a little "training" to loosen your imperial nerves.
If you wish to test the endurance of an immortal, I shall grant you your request.
Oho! I'm just praying things won't be lethal for me.
Let the morning sun and I burn away those royal doubts!
